stories.title: Teacher cuffed at Michigan meeting for clapping against data center
stories.dek: A teacher was arrested after clapping during public comments opposing a data center proposal at a city commission meeting in Michigan's Upper Peninsula. The incident highlights how heated local fights over data centers have become. Residents worry about noise, power rates, and water use from the projects.
stories.source_title: Teacher arrested for repeatedly clapping in favor of data center opponents during city commission meeting - Upper Michigan's Source

stories.title: Utica extends data center ban, shielding residents from new builds
stories.dek: Utica City Council voted to prolong its existing moratorium on data centers. The move keeps large-scale projects out of the Macomb County city for now, protecting local power and water capacity from sudden demand spikes. Residents avoid immediate tax shifts or infrastructure strain tied to hyperscale facilities.
stories.source_title: Utica City Council approves extending data center moratorium - C&G Newspapers

stories.title: St. Clair County residents weigh data center noise against promised jobs
stories.dek: Times Herald opinion piece highlights growing tension in eastern Michigan over constant humming from new facilities. Local officials face pressure to balance tax revenue and construction work against complaints that the sound disrupts daily life. The debate reflects broader questions about how much industrial growth communities will accept for economic gains.
stories.source_title: Michigan data centers: Noise vs. growth | Opinion - Times Herald

stories.title: Dowagiac data center noise pushes residents to sue for buyouts
stories.dek: Neighbors say the constant hum from the facility sounds like a vacuum running nonstop and violates local noise rules. The company has already been fined and is now offering to purchase affected homes. Michigan readers nearby face the same quality-of-life hit if more projects move in without stronger sound limits.
stories.source_title: 'It sounds like someone set up a vacuum, like in your living room': Michigan residents sue AI data center emitting noise 24/7 — company fined for industrial noise ordinance violations, offers to buy h

stories.title: Chippewa County pushes to freeze new data centers
stories.dek: County leaders are weighing a temporary moratorium that would halt any fresh data-center proposals while they study impacts on land, power and local services. Residents in the eastern Upper Peninsula could see development pressure shift or stall depending on the outcome. The move comes as data-center interest grows across Michigan's rural counties.
stories.source_title: Chippewa County looks to temporary moratorium on data centers - Leader-Telegram

stories.title: Senate candidates split on letting data centers drive up Michigan power bills
stories.dek: Democratic primary contenders laid out different plans for regulating data-center electricity demand and protecting ratepayers from new transmission costs. The exchange shows which candidates would push utilities or tech firms to cover upgrades versus spreading costs across all customers. Primary voters now have concrete differences on an issue that will hit monthly bills.
stories.source_title: How Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidates differ on immigration, healthcare, data centers - Michigan Public

stories.title: Indiana Michigan Power pledges to shield ratepayers from data center costs
stories.dek: The utility serving parts of southwest Michigan signed a pledge promising residential customers will not foot the bill for new data center power lines. The move comes amid growing concern that AI-driven demand could drive up monthly electric bills across the state. Local officials and consumer groups are watching to see how the commitment holds up in rate cases.
stories.source_title: I&M signs White House’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge - News/Talk/Sports 94.9 WSJM

stories.title: Garfield Township freezes data centers after sloppy project filing
stories.dek: Garfield Township supervisors moved to block new data centers for at least a year after an incomplete application arrived. Residents near the proposed site now face uncertainty over power lines, water use and property values. The pause gives the township time to write rules before any large project locks in.
stories.source_title: Garfield Township Tees Up Data Center Moratorium; Incomplete Application Submitted for Project - The Ticker

stories.title: DTE customers may foot bigger bills as data centers boost utility profits
stories.dek: DTE Energy’s Q2 preview highlights data-center growth as a key earnings driver for the Detroit-based utility. That expansion means more demand on the grid, which often translates into higher rates or new infrastructure costs passed to households. Michigan ratepayers have already seen added charges tied to similar projects elsewhere in the service territory.
stories.source_title: DTE Energy: Q2 Earnings Preview, A Regulated Utility With Data-Center Tailwinds (NYSE:DTE) - Seeking Alpha

stories.title: Calhoun County weighs year-long halt on new data centers over jobs and power
stories.dek: Commissioners are debating a moratorium after hearing concerns about electricity strain and whether promised economic gains will reach local taxpayers. A pause would delay projects that could draw hundreds of megawatts and millions of gallons of water. Residents in Battle Creek and surrounding townships would see the decision affect both future tax revenue and monthly utility costs.
stories.source_title: Calhoun County commissioners discuss data center moratorium and economic impacts - Yahoo

stories.title: Augusta Township nears vote on Oracle-scale data center rules
stories.dek: Augusta officials are set to decide on zoning and tax terms for a large data-center proposal that would pull power from the same DTE territory as Saline. The outcome determines how much new load hits ratepayers and whether the township collects meaningful revenue. A yes vote would add to the string of projects reshaping Washtenaw County's tax base and electricity demand.
stories.source_title: Weekly Data Center Watch: Saline Reverses Tax Break Limit as Augusta Vote Nears - The Sun Times News

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
